dimensions.description:
Every metric has specific characteristics that describe it, and you can think of dimensions as categories for
those characteristics. You can assign up to ten dimensions to a metric.

startTime.description: The time stamp that determines the first data point to return.

endTime.description: The time stamp that determines the last data point to return.

period.description:
The granularity, in seconds, of the returned data points. A period can be as short as one minute (60 seconds) and
must be a multiple of 60. The default value is 300.

statistics.description:
The metric statistic types of interest and will be output in the AwsCloudWatchdataPoint. If empty then all
statistics will be retrieved
